name: Maplibre Pmtiles Patterns
summary: Serverless vector and raster tiles with PMTiles for MapLibre GL JS — single-file format, HTTP range requests, hosting on S3/R2/GitHub Pages, generating with Planetiler or tippecanoe, and the pmtiles protocol. Use when you need no tile server or want to host tiles from static storage.

name: Maplibre Tile Sources
summary: How to choose and configure data sources for MapLibre GL JS — rendering your own data without tiles, hosted tile services, serverless PMTiles, self-hosted tile servers, tile schemas, and sprites.
